phrasing_rule: fit episodes use A.TPL_DIAG[0] at every operator position; test episodes use A.TPL_DIAG[1] at every operator position; operator-span strings are disjoint across fit and test

positions.note: k=3 is the mouth-facing terminal packet

strata: semantic: test values at k in {1,2}
position: fit values at k in {0,3}
joint: test values at k in {0,3}

orthogonal.form: one 896x896 Procrustes rotation per ordered pair, shared across both packet vectors and both fitting positions; slot-specific fitting-set means removed/restored

linear.regularization: lambda chosen on a fitting-set inner split (per-pair), then refit on all nine fitting values

nonlinear.pass_rule: >=2 of 3 mapper seeds cross every functional gate

mappers.position_specific_variants: same three classes fitted per packet position (preregistered diagnostic, frozen alongside the global maps)
mappers.training_target: reproduce the recipient model's natural packet state (instance -> recipient class centroid); no labels, task loss, mouth outputs, or gradients through the recipient model
mappers.post_map: RMS renormalization per the packet convention; no test-dependent scaling

contexts.primary: family-A pure-carrier (A value span + A structural forwarders)
contexts.secondary: family-D value/context layout with A structural forwarders (Appendix F S3 layout), no refitting
